name: Listmonk
author: Mox Neo
description: Self-hosted newsletter and mailing-list manager using the official Listmonk image and an external PostgreSQL database.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server/uploads
cat > /mnt/server/README-PTERODACTYL.txt <<'EOF'
Listmonk requires an external PostgreSQL 12 or newer database.
Set the database variables in the Pterodactyl Startup tab.
After starting, configure filesystem media uploads as:
/home/container/uploads
EOF

cat > /mnt/server/start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd /home/container
umask 077
PW_FILE=/home/container/.listmonk-admin-password
LISTMONK_ADMIN_USER="${LISTMONK_ADMIN_USER:-admin}"
[ -n "$LISTMONK_ADMIN_USER" ] || LISTMONK_ADMIN_USER=admin
if [ -n "${LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
  if [ "${#LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD}" -lt 12 ]; then
    echo "[listmonk] LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD must be at least 12 characters"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  # Never start with a blank admin password: that lets the first visitor
  # create the admin account. Generate one and keep it across restarts.
  if [ ! -s "$PW_FILE" ]; then
    head -c 24 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' > "$PW_FILE"
    printf 'Listmonk first login\nuser=%s\npassword=%s\nChange it in Listmonk (Users) after logging in, then delete this file.\n' \
      "$LISTMONK_ADMIN_USER" "$(cat "$PW_FILE")" > /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt
    chmod 600 "$PW_FILE" /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt
    echo "[listmonk] generated admin password; see /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt"
  fi
  LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD=$(cat "$PW_FILE")
fi
export LISTMONK_ADMIN_USER LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD
export LISTMONK_app__address="0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT}"
/listmonk/listmonk --install --idempotent --yes --config=""
/listmonk/listmonk --upgrade --yes --config=""
exec /listmonk/listmonk --config=""
EOF
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/start.sh
echo 'Listmonk server files prepared.'

variables.name: Database Connection Lifetime
variables.description: Maximum lifetime of a database connection, such as 300s.

variables.name: Database Maximum Idle Connections
variables.description: Maximum number of idle PostgreSQL connections.

variables.name: Database Maximum Open Connections
variables.description: Maximum number of open PostgreSQL connections.

variables.name: Initial Admin Password
variables.description: Admin password for first install (min 12). Leave blank to auto-generate one; it is saved to /home/container/FIRST_LOGIN.txt. Listmonk never starts with a blank admin password.

variables.name: Initial Admin Username
variables.description: Optional initial Super Admin username. Used only during the first database installation.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

variables.name: PostgreSQL SSL Mode
variables.description: Use disable for a trusted private network, or require/verify-full when PostgreSQL is configured for TLS.
